concept: 京张共行贡献墙 (Jingzhang Co-Mobility Contribution Wall)

honor_display_system.location: 共行零点广场（PS-001）+ 众智园发布测试广场（PS-002）双址

display_layers.content_zh: 志愿者代收、无障碍陪行、社区共测的贡献记录（经本人同意后展示）
display_layers.content_en: Contribution records of volunteer pickup, accessibility accompaniment and community co-testing (displayed with consent)

display_layers.content_zh: 开源共行规则库贡献者、仿真数据集标注者
display_layers.content_en: Contributors to the open-source co-mobility rule library and simulation dataset annotators

display_layers.content_zh: 通过 BEQUEST 审计的服务方与独立评估机构
display_layers.content_en: Service providers passing BEQUEST audit and independent evaluators

honor_display_system.inclusion_rule_zh: 展示以自愿与知情同意为前提；不展示任何个人轨迹、订单或画像数据；贡献墙数据与调度系统物理隔离。
honor_display_system.inclusion_rule_en: Display requires voluntary informed consent; no personal trajectories, orders or profiles are shown; wall data is physically separated from the dispatch system.
honor_display_system.non_ai_equivalent: 纸面贡献名册与年度张贴

component_library.blackout_behavior: 断电后转为人工服务点；模块可整体吊装迁移
component_library.materials: 银灰铝板 + 京张绿标识带

component_library.blackout_behavior: 可断电收储；底座保留为座椅
降级为普通慢行座椅区
断电后纸面信息槽仍可用（BEQUEST 资产）
纯机械结构，不依赖供电
可整体撤除还原慢行道
断电后保留纸面名册槽（BEQUEST 资产）
